_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Enzan's Brother#000.src: Good day for baking, aye recruit? I might need some assistance later, come back when you are level {~}!
Enzan's Brother#000.dst: Buen día para hornear, ¿eh, recluta? Puede que luego necesite ayuda; ¡vuelve cuando tengas el nivel {~}!

Enzan's Brother#001.src: You can even take your pals along with you for free if you're in a party!
Enzan's Brother#001.dst: ¡Si vas en grupo, hasta puedes llevar gratis a tus colegas!

Enzan's Brother#002.src: Welcome to the V.S.S. Seaskipper, from Seasail Enterprises! There's nothin' better than Seasail if you're lookin' to travel!
Enzan's Brother#002.dst: ¡Bienvenido al V.S.S. Seaskipper, de Seasail Enterprises! ¡Si quieres viajar, no hay nada mejor que Seasail!

Enzan's Brother#003.src: Just hop on the boat and buy a pass so you can get goin' to almost anywhere on the ocean!
Enzan's Brother#003.dst: ¡Súbete al barco y compra un pase para llegar a casi cualquier punto del océano!

Enzan's Brother#004.src: Talk to Enzan close to the exit of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Enzan's Brother#004.dst: Habla con Enzan cerca de la salida de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Enzan's Brother#005.src: Talk to Enzan close to the exit of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Enzan's Brother#005.dst: Habla con Enzan cerca de la salida de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Enzan's Brother#006.src: I see you want to venture into the wilderness!
Enzan's Brother#006.dst: ¡Veo que quieres adentrarte en tierras salvajes!
Enzan's Brother#006.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#007.src: My name is Enzan, and I am now a retired knight. I've spent most of my life fighting for {p}'s army, just like you.
Enzan's Brother#007.dst: Me llamo Enzan y ahora soy un caballero retirado. Como tú, he pasado casi toda mi vida luchando en el ejército de {p}.
Enzan's Brother#007.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#008.src: I know how hard it must be to be a recruit at this time, so I've got something that could help you! Well, I don't have it, but my brother does!
Enzan's Brother#008.dst: Sé lo duro que es ser recluta ahora mismo, ¡así que tengo algo que podría ayudarte! Bueno, yo no lo tengo, ¡lo tiene mi hermano!
Enzan's Brother#008.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#009.src: Follow this road, he's just past the item identifier, you can't miss him. Just head to the big set of stairs, past the item identifier.
Enzan's Brother#009.dst: Sigue este camino: está justo pasado el Identificador de objetos, no tiene pérdida. Ve a la gran escalera, pasado el Identificador.
Enzan's Brother#009.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#010.src: Tell him I sent you! He can be such a jerk to strangers sometimes, especially when he's focused on his stairs...
Enzan's Brother#010.dst: ¡Dile que te envío yo! A veces es muy borde con los desconocidos, sobre todo si anda con su escalera...
Enzan's Brother#010.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#011.src: Find Enzan's brother near the Item Identifier on the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Enzan's Brother#011.dst: Encuentra al hermano de Enzan cerca del Identificador de objetos en {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Enzan's Brother#012.src: Excuse me? Can't you see I'm busy?
Enzan's Brother#012.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#013.src: Oh, my brother? Sorry, I didn't know.
Enzan's Brother#013.dst: ¿Ah, mi hermano? Perdona, no lo sabía.
Enzan's Brother#013.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#014.src: Why yes, I actually have something that could help you...
Enzan's Brother#014.dst: Pues sí, la verdad es que tengo algo que podría ayudarte...
Enzan's Brother#014.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#015.src: But before I give it to you, why don't you help me with something first?
Enzan's Brother#015.dst: Pero antes de dártelo, ¿por qué no me echas tú una mano primero?
Enzan's Brother#015.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#016.src: You see, there's a special kind of mushroom that grows in this cave. I hear it has certain... energizing properties.
Enzan's Brother#016.dst: Verás, en esta cueva crece una seta muy especial. Dicen que tiene ciertas propiedades... energizantes.
Enzan's Brother#016.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#017.src: If you can bring me [{~} Energy Mushroom], I'll help you out. Enter the cave down the stairs, and bring me that mushroom!
Enzan's Brother#017.dst: Si me traes [{~} Energy Mushroom], te ayudo. ¡Baja por la escalera hasta la cueva y tráeme esa seta!
Enzan's Brother#017.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#018.src: Descend into the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Energy Mushroom] to Therck
Enzan's Brother#018.dst: Baja a la cueva en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y lleva [{~} Energy Mushroom] a Therck

Enzan's Brother#019.src: It's a very good ring for someone starting out like you. There's just one small issue...
Enzan's Brother#019.dst: Es un anillo muy bueno para alguien que empieza como tú. Solo hay un pequeño problema...
Enzan's Brother#019.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#020.src: To wear it, you must help my friend back in {p}. He's been pestering me for days about needing help.
Enzan's Brother#020.dst: Para poder llevarlo, ayuda a mi amigo en {p}. Lleva días dándome la lata con que necesita ayuda.
Enzan's Brother#020.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#021.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u} .
Enzan's Brother#021.dst: Nos vemos allí cuando seas un poco más fuerte. Bueno, hasta pronto, {u}.

Enzan's Brother#022.src: Ah, you're back. Do you have the mushroom?

Enzan's Brother#023.src: Excellent... Now I might finally be able to climb these stairs...
Enzan's Brother#023.dst: Excelente... Puede que por fin logre subir esta escalera...

Enzan's Brother#024.src: Who knows, maybe there's a treasure or something up there?
Enzan's Brother#024.dst: Quién sabe, ¿igual hay un tesoro ahí arriba?

Enzan's Brother#025.src: Take this ring. It's an accessory item. You can identify it at the nearby Item Identifier.
Enzan's Brother#025.dst: Toma este anillo. Es un accesorio. Puedes identificarlo en el Identificador de objetos de al lado.
